name_original: Hero of Belarus
grade_material_clues: Hero of Belarus    BLR001  Герой Беларусі      Title was instituted on 13 April 1995.   Title is awarded to citizens of Belarus who perform great deeds in the name of freedom, independence and prosperity of the Republic of Belarus.                Belarus

page_title: Order of the Fatherland
name_original: Order of the Fatherland
grade_material_clues: Order of the Fatherland    BLR002  Ордэн Айчыны      Order was instituted on 13 April 1995.   Order is awarded for excellent results in the manufacturing, scientific, social and cultural, charity and other activities aimed at promoting wellbeing of people and strengthening the power of the state; gallantry and bravery displayed while protecting the Fatherland and its state interests, enforcing the law and public order; significant contribution to the development of economic, scientific and cultural ties between the Republic of Belarus and other countries.   Order is awarded in three classes.                    Belarus

page_title: Order for Promotion of Peace and Friendship
name_original: Order for Promotion of Peace and Friendship
grade_material_clues: Order for Promotion of Peace and Friendship    BLR003  Ордэн За ўмацаванне міру і дружбы      Order was instituted on 27 May 2017.   Order is awarded to leaders of foreign states, high-ranking officials working in state bodies of foreign countries, outstanding politicians and public figures in recognition of: considerable achievements in the enhancement of bilateral relations with the Republic of Belarus, provision of full assistance in its socio-economic development and prosperity; significant personal contribution to the establishment of friendly relations and economic cooperation between the states, the integration of the Republic of Belarus in international associations; active peacemaking activities, harmonization of international relations, sponsorship aid and organization of high-profile humanitarian events for the benefit of humanity, promotion of unity and harmony in the global community.                Belarus

name_original: Order of Military Glory
grade_material_clues: Order of Military Glory    BLR004  Ордэн Воінскай Славы      Order was instituted on 13 April 1995.   Order is awarded to the military of the Republic of Belarus in recognition of: outstanding achievements in managing troops, maintaining their high combat readiness and professional training; bravery and selflessness in protecting the Fatherland and its state interests, in the execution of other service duties; contribution to enhancing comradeship-in-arms and military cooperation with foreign states.                Belarus

Belarus

Order is awarded in three classes.                        Belarus

Belarus

Belarus
